headlines.title: Accenture (ACN) Is Up 10.4% After Dividend Hike And New AI Deals With Dell And Workday
headlines.summary: In early October 2026, Accenture reported fourth-quarter and full-year results showing higher sales and earnings, confirmed guidance for fiscal 2027, increased its quarterly dividend to US$1.71 per share, completed a long-running share repurchase program, and outlined multi-year growth and margin goals at its investor day.

headlines.title: How to Play WDAY Stock as Workday Nabs a Major Anthropic Deal
headlines.summary: Workday’s Anthropic deal is strengthening its AI ambitions, putting WDAY’s growth prospects and enterprise adoption in sharper focus.

headlines.title: Accenture and Workday Promise a Faster Path to Measurable AI Impact. The Path Has No Numbers on It.
headlines.summary: The enterprise AI conversation used to be about what the software can do. This month it is about how fast the proof will arrive. In an October 13, 2026 announcement, Accenture and Workday launched a Forward Deployed Engineering program that embeds engineers alongside client HR and finance teams to get Workday agents into production.

headlines.title: Metaview Expands Workday Integration to Bring Agentic Recruiting to the Fortune 500
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO & NEW YORK & LONDON, October 14, 2026--Metaview, the Agentic Recruiting Platform trusted by more than 7,000 companies, today announced an expanded two-way integration with Workday, the enterprise AI platform for HR, finance and IT. The announcement builds on Metaview's growing traction among enterprise and Fortune 500 companies, enabling organizations to deploy AI agents across recruiting while maintaining their existing systems, security, and controls.

headlines.title: Workday to purchase C1.ai for AI agent access governance
headlines.summary: C1.ai's platform automates identity permissions across hundreds of business applications for both human workers and autonomous software agents.

description: Workday, Inc. provides enterprise cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company offers a suite of financial management applications to maintain accounting information; manage financial processes, such as payables and receivables; identify real-time financial, operational, and management insights; perform financial consolidation; reduce time-to-close; promote internal control and auditability; and achieve consistency across finance operations. It also provides spend management solutions that help organizations to streamline supplier selection and contract management, build and execute sourcing events, such as requests for proposals, and manage indirect spend; expense management solutions to submit and approve expenses; and a suite of human capital management applications that enables HR teams to hire, onboard, pay, develop, reskill, and provide employee experiences. In addition, the company offers planning applications. Further, it provides supply chain and inventory solutions to healthcare organizations; solutions to manage the end-to-end student and faculty lifecycle; Workday Extend for customers and their developers to build custom applications. The company serves the professional and business services, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, media, education, government, technology, media, retail, and hospitality industries. It sells its solutions through its direct sales organization. The company was formerly known as North Tahoe Power Tools, Inc. and changed its name to Workday, Inc. in July 2005. Workday, Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, California.
